meta.title: Usage balance card
meta.description:
English: A side balance card with balance, previous-turn spend, and current-turn spend. Amounts are light red, the running dot/label is yellow, a balance above ¥50 is blue, and the context ring turns orange at 60% and red at 90%. The card also shows turns, steps, speed, tokens, cache hit rate, and context; the balance and other information are 14px, and “Context” is 13px. Three features switch independently; all are on by default on first enable, and every later change is recorded and restored after a DSH restart. With Show other information off the card keeps only balance/previous/current, and the native statistics row follows the switch; with the balance card off and Show other information off, the native row disappears completely. A Usage trajectory tab records per-turn tokens, cache hit rate, cost, duration, peak window, and model names with versions. The plugin reads local Session projections and the account balance only; it makes no model requests and adds no token charges.

中文：在对话框左侧显示余额、上一轮消费和本轮消费；金额为浅红色，进行中的点和文字为黄色，余额大于 ¥50 时为蓝色，上下文进度达到 60% 变橙色、达到 90% 变红色。卡片还显示轮次、步骤、速度、Token、缓存命中率和上下文；余额数字和其他信息 14px，“上下文”三个字 13px。三个功能可独立开关，首次启用默认全部开启，之后每次切换立即记录并在 DSH 重启后恢复。关闭“显示其他信息”时卡片只保留余额、上一轮和本轮消费，原生统计行按开关显示；余额卡片关闭且“显示其他信息”关闭时原生统计行完全消失。另提供“使用量轨迹”页签，按轮次记录 Token、缓存命中率、费用、耗时和高峰时段，并显示带版本号的模型名。本插件只读取本地会话投影和账户余额，不调用模型，不会额外消耗 Token。
